subject: Web Development
title: Node.js: JavaScript on the Server
description: A quick, practical guide to Node.js: JavaScript on the Server.

hook.text: In 2009, Ryan Dahl had a radical idea: run JavaScript outside the browser.

buildup.text: He took Chrome's V8 engine and wrapped it with file system and network APIs.

discovery.text: Node.js let developers use one language for both frontend and backend code.

twist.text: Critics said JavaScript was too quirky for servers. Node proved them wrong at Netflix scale.

climax.text: Node.js created an ecosystem of millions of packages and changed how software is built.

punchline.text: A browser language escaped and conquered servers.
